output_name_hint: Edit the file name directly; it is always saved as WAV
center_extraction_tip: After cancellation, focus on the coherent center vocal; when off, only reference-mask cancellation runs
weak_vocal_protection_tip: With center extraction enabled, protects a quiet live vocal with a plain Mid fallback while sides stay attenuated
auto_align_tip: Matches version differences by musical onsets first, then refines with cross-correlation and local drift tracking
preview_empty: The output can be previewed here after processing
preview_error: Cannot play this audio; check the system audio backend
resampling: Resampling accompaniment to match the song sample rate...
align_fail: Auto-alignment failed; using the original timeline...
auto_found: A possible accompaniment file was found automatically
auto_not_found: No matching accompaniment file found; choose one manually
warn_invalid_parameters: Invalid processing parameters; check the parameter settings.
warn_same_inputs: The song and accompaniment must be different files; choose another accompaniment.
warn_output_conflict: The output file must not overwrite the song or accompaniment file.
home_intro: From reference-mask cancellation to AI track separation, handle clear, controllable vocal processing in one workspace.
home_choose_hint: Pick the workflow that fits your material, then adjust processing and output settings on the next screen.
home_mr_meta: Single song or full stage: live recording + matching source audio
home_mr_description: Precise single-song cancellation, or import multiple sources and generate a full-stage timeline automatically; both modes share the same processing parameters.
home_ai_description: Separate vocals and background automatically with a selectable AI model; no reference is needed, and the chosen model downloads on first run.
stage_output_hint: By default the full-stage vocal WAV is written next to the stage audio
stage_sources_hint: Add every available source in any order; each song is identified independently and placed in stage time order.
stage_timeline_hint: Uncheck to exclude promo clips that are not part of the official stage; double-click a stage time or source range to correct it manually. Unmatched sections are kept as-is.
stage_ready: First load the full-stage audio and add the available sources.
stage_need_audio: Please choose the full-stage audio first!
stage_need_sources: Please add at least one source!
stage_need_analysis: Run auto-arrange first and check the timeline.
stage_analysis_summary: Found {songs} full songs and {fragments} extra fragments; {missing} sources were not found.
stage_manual_updated: Timeline edited manually; full-stage cancellation will use the current checks and time ranges.
stage_invalid_edit: Invalid time range format; use "minutes:seconds.milliseconds - minutes:seconds.milliseconds" and make the end later than the start.
stage_render_loading: Loading the full stage and building the output timeline...
log_level_description: Sets the minimum level for GUI, CLI, background task, and Qt messages immediately
update_unavailable: No release source is configured, so this feature is unavailable
ai_model_need_download: Download needed; it downloads automatically on the first extraction
mdl_kuielab_b: Trained on MUSDB by the MDX-Net paper authors (kuielab)
ai_need_song: Please choose a song file first!
ai_err_model_load: Failed to load the AI model: {msg}
